mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical twenty-period Commodity Channel Index returning inside its +/-100 envelope on completed four-hour BTC auctions marks an extreme typical-price displacement beginning to normalize; follow the re-entry direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when CCI crosses strictly above -100 after being at or below -100; short when it crosses strictly below +100 after being at or above +100
mechanism.why_distinct: Stochastic compares close location within rolling extrema and RSI smooths signed close changes. HVCCI standardizes four-hour typical price by rolling mean absolute deviation and trades only envelope re-entry, with no stochastic/RSI line crossover, OI, flow, volume, funding, fitted outcome, prior event, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour robust typical-price deviation re-entry clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.center: simple mean of latest 20 completed typical prices
features.mean_deviation: simple mean of absolute latest-20 typical-price deviations from that same center
features.cci: (current typical price-center)/(0.015*mean_deviation), invalid when deviation is zero
features.reentry: current CCI strictly crosses inward through -100 or +100 from immediately prior valid CCI
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical typical-price mean-deviation envelope re-entry under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no CCI period, constant, level, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: Donald Lambert, canonical Commodity Channel Index convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: 20 completed periods; typical price=(high+low+close)/3; CCI=(TP-SMA20)/(0.015*mean absolute deviation); +/-100 envelope re-entry
external_basis.selection_use: published period, constant, levels, and re-entry direction only; no incidence or outcomes
